content.text: In Kenya, digital creators face a stark reality: Stripe and PayPal are not options. This isn’t a temporary glitch—it’s a systemic lock-out. To sell ebooks, courses, or templates, you need [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-5|infrastructure]] that doesn’t depend on Western payment processors. Crypto solves the payment problem, but not the infrastructure one. Hosting, delivery, and automation require tools that don’t collapse under currency volatility or geopolitical restrictions. This breakdown compares three paths to sovereign commerce: renting platforms, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-everything-you-need-19|Building a]] from scratch, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-step-step-25|COREMERCH guide to deploying]] COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit. Each option has tradeoffs. We’ll name them directly. The goal isn’t to sell you anything—it’s to show you which architecture aligns with your constraints and ambitions.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-11. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

Renting platforms like Gumroad or Podia is the path of least resistance—until it isn’t. They handle hosting, payments, and delivery in exchange for a subscription fee and a cut of your revenue. The problem? They’re built for markets where Stripe works. If your buyer’s payment fails, your product doesn’t deliver. Building from scratch gives you full control but demands time, technical skill, and ongoing maintenance. You’ll need to integrate crypto payment gateways, write backend logic for file delivery, and ensure your infrastructure scales. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit ($197) sits between these extremes. It provides pre-configured stacks using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. You own the code, deploy it yourself, and avoid recurring fees. The tradeoff? You’re responsible for deployment, though the kit includes step-by-step guides. If you want sovereignty without starting from zero, this is your option.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Renting platforms fail in restricted countries because their payment processors do. If Stripe or PayPal blocks a transaction, your buyer can’t complete their purchase. Building from scratch lets you integrate crypto gateways directly, but you’ll need to handle edge cases like fluctuating exchange rates and network congestion. COREMERCH’s stacks use NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and verifies payments on-chain. This works even if your buyer’s local currency is unstable. The key difference? COREMERCH’s architecture decouples payment processing from platform dependency. Your store runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally accessible. If NOWPayments ever goes down, you can swap it for another gateway without rebuilding your entire stack. This modularity is how infrastructure survives in volatile markets.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Renting platforms charge 5-10% per transaction plus monthly fees. Crypto payments through NOWPayments cost 0.5%. The catch? Crypto networks have their own fees. BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. Building from scratch lets you optimize for the cheapest networks, but you’ll spend time coding and debugging. COREMERCH’s stacks come pre-integrated with NOWPayments and recommend low-fee networks. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook to reduce costs as your volume grows. The real cost difference here isn’t just fees—it’s time. Renting platforms save you setup time but lock you into recurring costs. Building from scratch saves you money long-term but requires months of development. COREMERCH’s kit is the middle ground: deploy in days, own forever, and pay no subscriptions.
COREMERCH’s stacks are built for markets where Stripe and PayPal don’t work.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Renting platforms own your customer data, product files, and payment history. If they shut down or ban your account, you lose everything. Building from scratch gives you full ownership but requires you to manage storage, delivery, and backups. COREMERCH’s stacks use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage, and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automation. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure. You own the code, the data, and the customer relationship. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates for automated delivery—once a payment confirms on-chain, the file is sent instantly. This level of ownership and automation is why creators in Zimbabwe, Venezuela, and Ethiopia use these stacks. They’re built for markets where infrastructure can’t fail.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re selling one product and don’t care about long-term ownership, renting a platform might work—until it doesn’t. If you have a developer on your team and six months to spare, building from scratch could save you money. For everyone else, COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit is the clear choice. It gives you sovereign infrastructure without the complexity of starting from zero. Deploy in 48 hours, own everything, and pay no recurring fees. The $197 price tag isn’t an expense—it’s an investment in architecture that doesn’t collapse when payment processors or currencies do. This isn’t a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure designed for the markets Stripe locked out. Choose based on what you can’t afford to lose.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use COREMERCH’s stacks if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes detailed guides for deployment. You don’t need to write code—just follow the steps. If you can use GitHub or Cloudflare, you can deploy these stacks.
What happens if NOWPayments stops working?
NOWPayments is modular in COREMERCH’s architecture. If it fails, swap it for another crypto gateway without rebuilding your stack. Your store remains operational.
Do I need to pay monthly fees after deployment?
No. COREMERCH’s stacks use free hosting and storage services. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% transaction charge. You own everything after deployment.
Which cryptocurrencies should I accept for low fees?
Use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks. Transactions cost under $0.10. The Complete Builder Kit includes recommendations for optimizing fees.
